70-centimeter band.subject: Telecom & Postal
70-centimeter band.question: 70 centimeters is very close to the third harmonic of _____, which allows sufficiently broadband 2–meter antennas to be used for 70 centimeters
70-centimeter band.fact: 70 centimeters is very close to the third harmonic of 2 meters, which allows sufficiently broadband 2–meter antennas to be used for 70 centimeters. Also, 2 meters is far enough away from 70 centimeters to make diplexers small and simple, making it easy to cross-band repeat signals between the two bands with a single dual-band radio.
